Score a fit's predictions

Source: R/score.R
survkit_score.Rd

Evaluate a fitted model's predictions at one or more horizons: the concordance index (discrimination) and the inverse-probability-of-censoring-weighted Brier score with its index of prediction accuracy (calibration and accuracy against a covariate-free Kaplan-Meier reference).

Usage

survkit_score(fit, data, times)

Arguments

fit

A survkit_fit with a right-censored survival::Surv(time, status) response.

data

A data frame carrying the response and covariates to score on (in-sample if it is the training data, out-of-sample otherwise).

times

Numeric horizons at which to score.

Value

A data frame with time, cindex (Harrell's C using predicted risk at that horizon), brier (IPCW Brier) and ipa (index of prediction accuracy).

Details

The inverse-probability-of-censoring-weighted Brier score at horizon \(t\) is $$BS(t) = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n \Big[ \frac{\big(0 - \hat S(t \mid x_i)\big)^2}{\hat G(T_i)} \mathbf{1}(T_i \le t, \delta_i = 1) + \frac{\big(1 - \hat S(t \mid x_i)\big)^2}{\hat G(t)} \mathbf{1}(T_i > t) \Big]$$ where \(\hat S(\cdot \mid x_i)\) is the predicted survival probability, \(\hat G\) is the Kaplan-Meier estimator of the censoring survival function, and the index of prediction accuracy is \(IPA(t) = 1 - BS(t) / BS_0(t)\) against a covariate-free reference \(BS_0\).

References

Graf E, Schmoor C, Sauerbrei W, Schumacher M. Assessment and comparison of prognostic classification schemes for survival data. Statistics in Medicine 1999; 18(17-18): 2529-2545. doi:10.1002/(SICI)1097-0258(19990915/30)18:17/18<2529::AID-SIM274>3.0.CO;2-5

See also

survkit_curve() for the predictions scored here.

Other model-fitting: is_survkit_refusal(), survkit(), survkit_cuminc(), survkit_power(), survkit_refusal(), survkit_rmst(), survkit_triangulate()

Examples

fit <- survkit(survival::Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex, survival::lung,
               method = "cox")
survkit_score(fit, survival::lung, times = c(200, 400, 600))
#>   time   cindex     brier        ipa
#> 1  200 0.602853 0.2094928 0.03700922
#> 2  400 0.602853 0.2318152 0.01245320
#> 3  600 0.602853 0.1646295 0.01890319
